face.name: 艾泽拉斯的勇士
face.text: 选择联盟或部落，获取2张该阵营的传说勇士并使其法力值消耗减少（2）点。
face.flavorText: 我们是勇士……魔兽世界的勇士！

face.name: Champions of Azeroth
face.text: Choose Alliance or Horde. Get 2 of their Legendary Champions and reduce their Costs by (2).
face.flavorText: Weeee are the champions of the Wooorld… of Warcraft!

face.name: 瓦里安·乌瑞恩
face.text: 战吼：抽三张牌。将抽到的随从牌直接置入战场。
face.flavorText: 联盟的统治者！安度因的父亲！同时他还喜欢玩竞技模式，场均12胜。

face.name: Varian Wrynn
face.text: Battlecry: Draw 3 cards. Put any minions you drew directly into the battlefield.
face.flavorText: Leader of the Alliance! Father of Anduin! Also he likes to play Arena, and he averages 12 wins.

face.name: 提里奥·弗丁
face.text: 圣盾，嘲讽，亡语：装备一把5/3的 灰烬使者。
face.flavorText: 如果你还没听过《提里奥·弗丁主题曲》，那是因为它还没被谱写出来。

face.name: Tirion Fordring
face.text: Divine Shield, Taunt Deathrattle: Equip a 5/3 Ashbringer.
face.flavorText: If you haven't heard the Tirion Fordring theme song, it's because it doesn't exist.

face.name: 大法师安东尼达斯
face.text: 每当你施放一个法术，将一张“火球术”法术牌置入你的手牌。
face.flavorText: 肯瑞托的首席法师，达拉然最伟大的子民，安东尼达斯在被巫妖王阿尔萨斯杀死之前，曾是吉安娜的导师。

face.name: Archmage Antonidas
face.text: Whenever you cast a spell, add a 'Fireball' spell to your hand.
face.flavorText: Antonidas was the Grand Magus of the Kirin Tor, and Jaina's mentor. This was a big step up from being Grand Magus of Jelly Donuts.

face.name: 布莱恩·铜须
face.text: 你的战吼会触发 两次。
face.flavorText: 自从铁炉堡的国王麦格尼华丽登场后，布莱恩也想像哥哥那样出一套英雄皮肤。

face.name: Brann Bronzebeard
face.text: Your Battlecries trigger twice.
face.flavorText: Contains 75% more fiber than his brother Magni!

face.name: 先知维伦
face.text: 使你的法术和英雄技能的伤害和治疗效果翻倍。
face.flavorText: 他被逐出了他的家园，他的兄弟们都变成了邪恶的主宰......但是除此之外，他好像也没有什么别的可以抱怨的了。

face.name: Prophet Velen
face.text: Double the damage and healing of your spells and Hero Power.
face.flavorText: He's been exiled from his home, and all his brothers turned evil, but otherwise he doesn't have a lot to complain about.

face.name: 格罗玛什·地狱咆哮
face.text: 冲锋 受伤时拥有+6攻 击力。
face.flavorText: 灰谷南方，来自地狱的咆哮还在回响。

face.name: Grommash Hellscream
face.text: Charge Has +6 Attack while damaged.
face.flavorText: Grommash drank the tainted blood of Mannoroth, dooming the orcs to green skin and red eyes! Maybe not his best decision.

face.name: 希尔瓦娜斯·风行者
face.text: 亡语：随机夺取一个敌方随从的控制权。
face.flavorText: 没有人比女王更渴望真正地死去。

face.name: Sylvanas Windrunner
face.text: Deathrattle: Take control of a random enemy minion.
face.flavorText: Sylvanas was turned into the Banshee Queen by Arthas, but he probably should have just killed her because it just pissed her off.

face.name: 凯恩·血蹄
face.text: 嘲讽。亡语：召唤一个5/5的贝恩·血蹄。
face.flavorText: 凯恩被加尔鲁什杀害了，所以...别把这张牌放在战士的套牌里，这完全说不通。

face.name: Cairne Bloodhoof
face.text: Taunt Deathrattle: Summon a 5/5 Baine Bloodhoof.
face.flavorText: Cairne was killed by Garrosh, so... don't put this guy in a Warrior deck. It's pretty insensitive.

face.name: 洛瑟玛·塞隆
face.text: 战吼： 使你牌库中所有随从牌的属性值翻倍。
face.flavorText: 他一生之中最神鳍的成就，就是把鱼人宝宝强化成了2/2。

face.name: Lor'themar Theron
face.text: Battlecry: Double the stats of all minions in your deck.
face.flavorText: Out of all his life accomplishments, making a 2/2 Tinyfin is his finest.

face.name: 暗影猎手沃金
face.text: 战吼：选择一个随从，与其拥有者手牌中的随机一个随从交换。
face.flavorText: 在赞达拉巨魔的路演里，你可看不到这么精彩的交换大戏。

face.name: Shadow Hunter Vol'jin
face.text: Battlecry: Choose a minion. Swap it with a random one in its owner's hand.
face.flavorText: You wouldn’t see this swap-meet on the Zandalari Roadshow.
